docs.text: This version shipped without a wiki ¶ Micro OS 0.5.0-rc1 was released before the wiki existed. The pages appeared with 0.5.0-rc2; there is no versioned copy of them to show for this tag, and inventing one would describe a tree nobody ran. The stable address of the wiki points at the newest stable tag, 0.8.0 ; until a stable release carries a wiki, this note is what it leads to. The release itself is still on GitHub: the tree of 0.5.0-rc1 and the source of the tag . If you want to... Read read the newest documentation 0.8.0 read the development branch dev see every version all versions The canonical documents of the project are in docs/ ; the wiki explains how to use the system, not why it is shaped the way it is.
